interpretation.drivenCaptureIsSequential: A driven UI is a stateful sequence — frame N depends on frames 0..N-1 — so the worker slicing in frame-capture.mjs (which relies on every frame being a pure function of masterTimeline.seek(t)) cannot be applied to a driven segment.
interpretation.note: Driven segments cost roughly 6x more wall-clock per frame than generated ones at 4K, purely from lost parallelism. Budget driven segments as a minority of total runtime, or capture them at a lower resolution and upscale at encode.
